The manifest was refreshed last.

The ten-byte writer is `0x609b3c79`. It reads fixed indices: `0x9a41` index 0 and `0x1dd1` indices 0 and 1, plus `0x84d1`, `0x88b2`, `0x1df1`, and `0x1e01` at index 0. It does not read `0x99a1`, `0x5962`, or the pose word `0xa32c568c`. A half-press did not enter that writer, its store at `0x609b3d3d`, the converter, or the triple reader, for any of the three poses with Orientation Linked on or off. Both ten-byte buffers and the dirty byte stayed 0 at those snapshots.

The direct editor is separate. Its settings reads go through the wrapper at `0x6041a1fb`. With the link on, landscape uses index 1, EXIF 6 uses index 5, and EXIF 8 uses index 3. With the link off, all three use index 1. Each pose was reached, each move changed the matching `0x5962` cell, and that run ended `ok: true`.

The raw-code stores are split by sign. Raw 0, 1, and 4 are stored at `0x60078025`, `0x60078052`, and `0x60077ff6`. Raw 2, 3, and 5 are stored at `0x6007805e` after a provisional store at the earlier site. The copy entry ran for every sample. All 12 cells of `0xe91` were 0 after each of the six axes.

`0x90a1` stayed `[1, 1]`, the Subject Detect off value. The store-trace process exited 1 only because that script required the key to be 0. Every intervention in `pose.mjs` is listed in `work/out/pose-injection.md`. The register read at `0x6006f28e` is the only one that supplies a pose sample.
